title: Own the actual scan session and source replacement lifecycle
scope: Implement the sole actual scan/session document, immutable mesh/source assets, revisions and scan replacement/reset lifecycle needed by scan.open and marked-plane commands. Reuse owned runtime/history/import components; do not substitute a fixture scalar or duplicate business store. Source audit names every captured family/plugin/reference continuation before exposing a command.
acceptance: Original-first independent real mesh/session traces compare buffers, IDs/revisions, named source metadata, exact units/poses, held measurements, reference preservation/drop and all invalidated maps/marks/history. Retain every earlier case and actual wrong-value rejection.

Failed/stale preparation leaves committed session intact; old asynchronous work cannot overwrite a replaced scan. Preserve commit/clear/dispose/discard and provider fault order. Native/Wasm builds remain required; platform viewer side effects stay explicit until integrated.

Then wire the complete supported scan import command, marked-plane fit, global undo/apply and original-compatible project/CLI save. Explicitly refuse unported formats/paths; no partial command body or generic callback counts as M3.
open_items: Actual data model not implemented. Start with source closure/ownership audit, then real mesh/session independent inputs. Runtime fixtures do not supply this model.
